title: This made me laugh
author: BRIDMARYGOKU1
selftext:
Professor Layton channel banning anyone discussing AI???? What have I done apart from having AI assist me in things I can't do on my own but have a passion for gaming.

I am trying to build a channel free with just my phone, ChatGPT and my own time to put together a retrospective of Professor Layton but then do different games.

Why does AI cause such a stink when people use it to help them try to accomplish something that they can't fully do on their own.

Anyways anyone who wants to check out my lonely video until I get the next one up later this week, please drop by, give me a like and a sub and hopefully you can watch the channel grow and hopefully show that AI can be used to help rather than hinder.

https://youtube.com/@thegeekygameruk

Many thanks for reading

Rob
